←  ☒ /model  ☐ MCP prompts  ✔ Submit  →

│ Claude's MCP prompts (e.g. /mcp__kicad__routing_strategy) are known only
│ inside the running Claude process: no file lists them, and the one listing API
│ (a `claude -p` initialize sidecar) ran an UNTRUSTED repo's SessionStart hook
│ in my test (ADR 0001). How should the chat's command list treat MCP prompts?

❯ 1. Leave them out (Recommended)
     The menu lists built-ins, your commands and skills, project commands/skills
     and plugin commands; MCP prompts stay a terminal feature for now, and the
     proposal records why.
  2. Allow by server name
     Accept a typed /mcp__<server>__<prompt> when <server> is an MCP server
     configured for Claude (read from ~/.claude.json and the plugins), without a
     description and unvalidated beyond that.
  3. Type something.
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  4. Chat about this

Enter to select · Tab/Arrow keys to navigate · Esc to cancel
